steps.text: Bring a small pot of water to the boil and salt it lightly. The pecorino brings plenty of its own salt.
Toast the cracked pepper in a dry, wide pan over medium heat until it smells sharp and floral.
Add the pasta to the water and cook it two minutes short of the packet time.
Mash the pecorino with a few spoons of the hot pasta water into a thick, smooth paste.
Ladle a mugful of pasta water into the pepper pan and let it bubble down by half.
Drag the pasta into the pepper pan and toss hard until the water turns glossy and clings.
Take the pan off the heat and wait half a minute, or the cheese will seize into strings.
Stir in the pecorino paste, tossing until creamy. Loosen with pasta water and serve at once.
